visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Dropdown With Select
visualizerParams.description: Type a select with three options and a default. The value of the chosen option is what the form sends, and the text is what the user sees.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<label for="size">Size</label>
<select id="size">
  <option value="s">Small</option>
  <option value="m" selected>Medium</option>
  <option value="l">Large</option>
</select>

checks.label: The Large option has the value l
